properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means water levels above flood stage are imminent or
may already be occurring. Persons along rivers and streams in the
warned area should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

These forecasts are based on observed precipitation as well as
forecast precipitation 24 hours into the future. Changes to the
rainfall forecast, or any additional rainfall after 24 hours, may
cause changes to these river forecasts.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued by late tonight.

Kellner Camp along County Road 336.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:15 PM CDT Sunday the stage was 38.5 feet.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

Manatee 7 Mile South Reef, Egmont Key, Sunshine Skyway Bridge,
Saint Pete Beach, Anna Maria Island, Pass-A-Grille Channel, Saint
Pete Beach Reef, Southwest Channel, Sarasota Bay, Port Manatee
Reef, Manatee 1 Mile Reef, Manatee 3 Mile South Reef, Manatee 7
Mile North Reef, Sarasota Bay Reef, Passage Key Inlet, Longboat
Pass, and Longboat Key.

expected.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 2 at 6:00PM EDT until August 2 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:
SMWBUF

The National Weather Service in Buffalo has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Erie from Ripley to Dunkirk...

* Until 800 PM EDT.

* At 559 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 20 nm
northwest of Ripley to 8 nm southwest of Erie, moving northeast at
25 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Van Buren Point, Barcelona, Ripley, and Dunkirk.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 2 at 4:09PM MDT until August 2 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
FFWABQ

The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Sacaton and Hummingbird burn scars in...
South Central Catron County in west central New Mexico...

* Until 715 PM MDT.

* At 409 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Sacaton and Hummingbird burn scars. Up to 1
inch of rain has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.75
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will impact Willow Creek and
Gilita Creek. This includes Willow Creek Road including the Ben Lilly
and Willow Creek Campgrounds and any other residences in this area.
Bursum Road near the Willow Creek Campground may also be impacted.
Middle Fork Trail number 157 and Iron Creek Trail number 172 will be
especially dangerous. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud,
vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Sacaton and Hummingbird
burn scars.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Sacaton and Hummingbird burn scars.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of South Central Catron County.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks, streams and ditches in
the Sacaton and Hummingbird burn scars. Severe debris flows can also
be anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away
in places. If you encounter flood waters, climb to safety.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:15 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:15 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.description:
FFWCTP

The National Weather Service in State College has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...

drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lewisburg, Mifflinburg, Winfield, Linntown, New Columbia,
Allenwood, Vicksburg, Forest Hill, Sand Bridge State Park, Spruce
Run Reservoir, R.B. Winter State Park, Laurelton Center, Weikert,
West Milton, New Berlin, Hartleton and Bucknell.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 2 at 5:21PM EDT until August 2 at 7:15PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:

flooding.

areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Williamsport, Montoursville, Montgomery, Duboistown, Cogan Station,
Trout Run, Loyalsockville, Ralston, Elimsport, Barbours,
Collomsville, South Williamsport, Garden View, Oval, Salladasburg,
Little League World Series Complex and Williamsport Airport.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
